entities.name: USER
entities.rationale: End user accessing the Orion portal to request a new environment.

entities.name: ROUTE 53
entities.rationale: Used for DNS resolution of the Orion portal request.

entities.name: ALB
entities.rationale: Application Load Balancer routing incoming traffic to the EKS cluster and pods.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service orchestrating the containerized workloads.

entities.name: SPOT
entities.rationale: 100% Spot instances running the Kubernetes pods and microservice jobs.

entities.name: SNS
entities.rationale: Amazon SNS receiving events when microservice jobs are triggered.

entities.name: SQS
entities.rationale: Amazon SQS queue storing state and unfinished jobs to ensure consistency during spot terminations.

visual_connections.description: User accesses the portal via HTTPS
Resolves DNS to the Application Load Balancer
Routes traffic to the EKS cluster
Routes traffic to the application pods running on Spot instances
Triggers events to SNS when microservice jobs are created
Fans out messages to SQS queue
New jobs watch SQS to resume unfinished tasks from terminated spot instances
